sources.note: Main homepage. Highlights Expanse as the current product, shows customer testimonials from community hospitals and health systems of various sizes. Lists HCA Healthcare, Humber River Health, Willis Knighton Health, Frederick Health, UPMC Ireland, Centre for Neuro Skills as notable customers with stats.

ONC regulatory/certification page listing all certified products across Expanse 2.2, 2.1, 6.1, 6.0, MAGIC, and Client/Server platforms. Shows separately certified modules including CCD interface, MyHealth Portal, public health interfaces (immunization, syndromic surveillance, reportable lab, electronic case reporting, cancer case reporting), Oncology, and MPM (Medical and Practice Management) for MAGIC and C/S. Reveals the HCA MAGIC variant.

Complete product/module listing. Shows 60+ modules organized into Clinical Solutions, Diagnostic Services, Care Coordination/Patient Engagement, Specialty Care, Revenue Cycle/Patient Access, and Business Operations. Confirms MEDITECH is a comprehensive HCIS, not just an EHR. Includes modules for Blood Bank, Pathology, Home Health, Hospice, Mental Health, Oncology, HR, Payroll, GL, AP, Materials Management, etc.

Expanse product page. Describes web-based platform with cloud/MaaS hosting, AI integration (Navigator, ambient listening), interoperability (Traverse Exchange, FHIR APIs), mobile capabilities (Expanse Now, Point of Care), revenue cycle, and BCA analytics. Lists customer examples including HCA Healthcare (182 hospitals, 2,300+ sites), Emanate Health, Hebrew SeniorLife, Bethany Children's, Centre for Neuro Skills, Fraser Health Authority, Blackrock Health, Aga Khan University Hospital.

Wikipedia article confirming founding in 1969, privately held, headquarters in Westwood MA. Revenue $493.8M (2019). Key acquisitions: Patient Care Technologies (2007), LSS Data Systems (2011), Centennial Computer Corporation (2018, UK). Platform history: MAGIC (1982), Client/Server (1994), 6.0 (2006), Expanse (2018). CEO Michelle O'Connor since 2021.

Becker's article on MEDITECH market share trends. Shows 14.8% U.S. acute care hospital market share in 2024, down from 16% in prior years. Third behind Epic (42.3%) and Oracle/Cerner (22.9%). Gradual decline due to migrations to Epic.

KLAS 2024 market share report. Notes over 60% of legacy MEDITECH users opting for go-forward systems chose Expanse in 2024, up from 30% in 2023. Confirms MEDITECH's strong retention among its existing base.
Software Advice reviews. 3.1/5 stars from 47 reviews. Users note real-time data integration, customizability, but also cite clunky UI, navigation issues, and occasional performance problems.
G2 reviews. 3.1/5 stars from 120 reviews. Mixed sentiment — praised for functionality breadth but criticized for dated UX compared to newer competitors.
Forbes Advisor editorial review. 4.0/5 rating. Highlights cost-effectiveness for small-to-midsize hospitals, comprehensive feature set, mobile support. Notes lack of pricing transparency.
MEDITECH press release on Best in KLAS recognition for 11th consecutive year (2025). #1 for Acute Care EHR: Small (1-150 beds) and Patient Accounting & Management for Small.

Press release on HCA Healthcare's large-scale Expanse deployment agreement — 182 hospitals, 2,300+ sites across 20 states and UK. Confirms HCA as MEDITECH's largest customer migrating from MAGIC to Expanse.
Press release confirming Expanse live in 43+ HCA Healthcare hospitals. Demonstrates active migration from MAGIC to Expanse.

CereCore guide on transitioning from legacy MEDITECH (MAGIC/C/S) to Expanse. Confirms that migration is essentially a full re-implementation, not a simple upgrade. Describes MAGIC as receiving only regulatory/safety updates.
MEDITECH's own migration benefits page encouraging legacy customers to move to Expanse.
Tegria consulting guide to MEDITECH Expanse. Provides overview of platform capabilities, web-based architecture, and module descriptions.
Taloflow product overview for MEDITECH Expanse. Covers patient engagement, practice management, telehealth, and market positioning insights.
